raw_response:
I farm only 6 mu, so I will keep the plan simple and steady. I will put 3 mu into garlic and then follow that same 3 mu with summer maize, because that rotation fits my land, my irrigation, and my labor. Garlic brings cash, but it needs more care, fertilizer, water, and spraying, so I will not put all 6 mu into it. I will keep the other 3 mu in wheat because wheat is familiar to me, safer, and easier to manage at my age, especially since some family members work off-farm and I cannot depend on a lot of labor at busy times. Because I have well irrigation, I will use moderate fertilizer and a few timely irrigations to protect yield, but I will not push input too high because that raises cost and risk. For seed, I will use hybrid maize for stable production, improved wheat seed for better stand and yield, and improved garlic cloves with even size so the crop comes out more uniform.
